record.context: Found by sweeping every campaign source with local text for numbered problem labels and comparing with the locator numbers of the rows carried for it; this label appeared in none.
record.result_status: RESOLUTION SEARCH RUN 2026-09-14: no resolution beyond what the source itself reports. Lewin's review already records its Theorem 36, which proves the energy crystallization conjecture for d = 1 on part of the range and for d = 8 and 24 through Cohn, Kumar, Miller, Radchenko and Viazovska combined with Petrache and Serfaty. Dimensions two and three, the triangular-lattice and FCC-BCC cases, were open in 2022 and nothing found since changes that.
